purpose: provide independent, evidenced assurance that controls operate as claimed, and track findings to closure
entry_criteria: Audit scope, criteria (policy or standard) and period are agreed
Auditor is independent of the controls being audited
Evidence sources and owners are named
procedure: Agree scope, criteria, period and sampling approach in writing.
Request evidence for a risk-based sample of controls and test both design and operation over the period.
Re-perform the control or verify the evidence independently; do not rely only on assertions.
Rate each finding with criteria, condition, cause and effect; agree corrective actions and dates with owners.
Issue the report with scope limits stated, then verify closure of each action independently.
Report overdue findings to the compliance owner.
acceptance_criteria: Each finding cites criteria and evidence
Auditor is independent of the audited control

validation.check: re-perform two sampled controls from raw evidence
validation.expect: results match the control owner's assertions or differences are logged

validation.check: confirm each corrective action has an owner and date

failure_modes.detection: Workpapers contain only screenshots of assertions

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A sample of ten access removals is tested. Two departed users kept access for 45 days against a 7-day policy. The finding is rated medium and closed after a re-extract shows the access removed.
